The existing Java goal runner reconstructs a verified at-rest world, substitutes one component, runs bounded alternatives and checks a fresh actual execution. Parent, child, trace and world revision stay linked.

The implemented loop

Verified episode → checked cold reconstruction → one component change → three native alternatives → optional review → fresh owned execution → original native and visible report checks → world commit and child episode.

Native simulated boxes and a virtual force/torque gripper. These results do not establish physical camera accuracy, arbitrary moving-state restoration, retrieval speedup or LLM-weight training. Prior controller promotion results remain unchanged.
